scope: Public primary materials consulted on November 9, 2026 ET. These findings distinguish matching access, current master reconciliation and missing protocol details. Historical receipts remain unchanged.

sources.finding: Current local roster still shows those three active opportunities. The combination of Gilvetmab, EGFR vaccination and carboplatin in histologically confirmed hemangiosarcoma is expressly labeled closed. The narrative mentions a carboplatin/EGFR comparison arm without a present enrollment invitation for that arm. TLR and FMT/Palladia are still coming soon. The separately active EGFR program is not closed by the combination entry.
sources.disposition: Prior sufficient roster confirmed; separate closed candidate resolved; comparison-arm recruitment unproven.

sources.finding: All three treatment identities in the currently linked July list were reread on their individual pages. In the same PDF, liver/adrenal coagulation, feline mammary margin imaging, STS immune profiling, STS microscopic extension and mast-cell lymph-node image analysis are distinct research or imaging projects. The PDF date is retained as July; do not infer November publication. No new cutoff or a changed treatment opportunity was established.
sources.disposition: Prior sufficient roster confirmed with study-level links.

sources.finding: The Santa Fe clinic states no trials currently enrolling. Both Immunocidin entries and Canalevia are under past trials. In-clinic prescribing does not reopen the supportive-care study, already absent from matching.

Both requests started 2026-11-10T01:48:14Z, completed 01:48:19Z and returned curl code 28 after a five-second connection timeout. No HTTP response and no fresh roster. The previous evening had already exhausted native retry and alternative routes. The morning roster and exact AVMA study evidence retain their original times.
sources.disposition: Fresh roster unavailable; retained morning snapshot is separate.

sources.finding: Tufts still explicitly lists its primary pulmonary carcinoma SBRT study as recruiting and specifies cost ceilings and exclusions; site search returned no additional primary VRTOG enrolling site for this exact protocol.
sources.disposition: Tufts local access retained; other-site roster unresolved.

sources.finding: UC Davis public gallery material still distinguishes TAE and novel-agent TACE. No IACUC mapping to Completed VCT26005956 was established in the institution or the targeted public registry search. Do not transfer status across arms.
sources.disposition: Exact closure scope remains an owner/status decision.

sources.finding: Florida remains the confirmed trametinib site. MSU's current official oncology list does not name trametinib; its histiocytic-sarcoma entry is the separate quasiorganelle study already in the catalog. UF's independent feline oral carcinoma LSD1 page contains an older recruiting introduction and explicitly marks enrollment paused in the enrollment section; the current feline master instead lists the existing RNA vaccine with limited enrollment.
sources.disposition: No extra trametinib site or active UF LSD1 listing established.

sources.finding: Current ESVONC page explicitly describes its listing as non-exhaustive. Rows for Frégis, VetAgro Sup, Italy mucosal melanoma vaccination, Portuguese ablation/PDT and Swiss sinonasal radiotherapy were used as candidate leads. The page is not an independent enrollment confirmation for those exact cohorts.
sources.disposition: Index read; unresolved exact organizer intake remains separate.

sources.finding: Sponsor explicitly invites Australian dogs with mast cell cancer to register for screening. It does not publish an activated-site roster, arm-level costs or a different currently enrolling cancer indication.
sources.disposition: Known sponsor intake signal confirmed; costs/sites unresolved.

sources.finding: Targeted searches return the historical eight-dog pilot and secondary reporting, with no newer investigator recruitment document or reliable closing notice for that exact cohort.
sources.disposition: Current enrollment, full eligibility and cost still unverified.

sources.finding: Investigator material supports the Liverpool DOG-FIGhT identity, distinct from UTSW's study. Targeted search did not establish a public patient intake page, full eligibility, charges or enrollment cutoff.

sources.finding: Sponsor still identifies FAM-010 as enrolling soon in Urbana and describes a fall opening. That season is not a date or proof that a dose group is taking new cases.

Current site names Salt Lake City as open, Cincinnati and Cleveland for established same-hospital patients, Pittsburgh for Pennsylvania dogs with local follow-up, and Chicago as paused. No new site was supported. The broad phrase about MedVet hospitals does not remove branch restrictions.
Two formulations in one trial for recently diagnosed appendicular long-bone osteosarcoma without metastasis. Current school document does not establish extra sites or coverage for surgery.
sources.disposition: Existing trial confirmed, extra logistics open.

sources.finding: UQ VETS lists the same appendicular osteosarcoma vaccine study; no separate open formulation protocol or new site. The historical Brisbane/Gatton announcement cannot settle current geographical eligibility or surgery payment.

The current named corporate anti-PD-1 treatment trial is oral malignant melanoma at three sites, matching the catalog. University historical materials discuss other cancers but do not show another currently enrolling anti-PD-1 cohort. Current anti-CD20 eligibility and costs remain unpublished.

The Zurich glioma protocol was last updated October 26 and states participation is possible. All patients get radiation; chemotherapy plus placebo comparison is already represented. No additional sinonasal study-level intake identified, and restricted separate flyers were not reopened.
sources.disposition: Known glioma study confirmed; other primary details open.

sources.finding: The targeted public Canadian and OVC searches returned no new exact therapeutic AML protocol. The earlier marrow-sampling project is documented in the historical official review; no fresh OVC master visit is claimed by this search.
